summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint configuration but its `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) fetches the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts the platform-specific binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against an adjacent 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line bundle with a rotated string-array decoder and hex-obfuscated identifiers, having no relationship to an ESLint configuration. The dropper `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscator.io-style renamed (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-function junk-object proxy tables), consistent with an implant rather than legitimate install tooling. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated sibling bypasses Node-based inspection and delivers attacker-controlled code execution to every installer on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
